baslik: ⚙️ SEXYKO GENIE SYSTEM | Start · Stop · 8+8+8 Skills · HP/MP Potions · Mob List · Attack Range

metin.Başlat • Durdur • Kalan Süreni Gör • Aya: Start • Stop • See Your Remaining Time • Manage Your Settings From One Panel
metin.SexyKO Genie sistemi, karakterinizin bel: The SexyKO Genie system is an advanced automation system that makes your character attack, use skills, manage HP/MP and run the farm automatically according to the rules you set.
metin.**Yeni Genie arayüzüyle birlikte sistemi: **With the new Genie interface, using and controlling the system is much more practical.**
metin.Oyun ekranında bulunan Genie kontrol pan: You can quickly control the system from the Genie control panel on the game screen.
metin.▶️ **BAŞLAT** — Genie sistemini aktif ed: ▶️ **START** — Activates the Genie system. Your character starts working automatically based on the skill, potion, mob and other settings you created earlier.
metin.⏹️ **DURDUR** — Aktif olan Genie sistemi: ⏹️ **STOP** — Stops the active Genie system. Use this when you want to end the farm or control your character manually.
metin.⏳ **KALAN GENIE SÜRESİ** — Panel üzerind: ⏳ **REMAINING GENIE TIME** — Track your current Genie time live on the panel. So you don't need to open another window to see how much Genie time you have left.
metin.⚙️ **AYARLAR** — Ayarlar butonuna tıklay: ⚙️ **SETTINGS** — Click the Settings button to open Genie's detailed control panel. Skill order, potion use, the monsters to attack and other automation settings are set here.
metin.Genie ayarlarını açtığınızda karakterini: When you open the Genie settings, you see the main panel where you decide how your character behaves while farming. From skill use to potion percentages, many details are completely under your control.
metin.⚔️ **ATTACK SKILLS — 8 ADET ATTACK SKILL: ⚔️ **ATTACK SKILLS — 8 ATTACK SKILL SLOTS** · Place the skills your character will use while attacking in this area. Genie uses the skills you place here in the order you set. This way you can build a different farm skill layout for each job.
metin.🟢 **SELF SKILLS — 8 ADET SELF SKILL SLOT: 🟢 **SELF SKILLS — 8 SELF SKILL SLOTS** · Place the skills your character will use on itself in this area. Buffs, class-specific support skills and abilities that must be used on yourself are managed here.
metin.👥 **PARTY SKILLS — 8 ADET PARTY SKILL SL: 👥 **PARTY SKILLS — 8 PARTY SKILL SLOTS** · Made for support skills to be used on party members. Very useful especially for party-support characters like Priests.
metin.📜 **SKILL & SCROLL ALANLARI** — Genie iç: 📜 **SKILL & SCROLL AREAS** — Besides skill use, Genie also has helper scroll areas. You can assign suitable scrolls and helper items you want used while farming to the Genie system. So your farm setup isn't just attack skills.
metin.❤️ **HP POT AYARLARI** — Genie karakteri: ❤️ **HP POTION SETTINGS** — Genie can track your character's HP automatically. You decide at which HP percentage the potion is used. For example, if set to **HP 60%**, Genie uses an HP potion automatically when your health reaches that level. You can change this rate depending on how hard your farm zone is.
metin.💙 **MP POT AYARLARI** — MP pot sistemi d: 💙 **MP POTION SETTINGS** — The MP potion system works the same way. You decide at which percentage of mana the potion is used. For example, if set to **MP 40%**, Genie uses an MP potion automatically when mana drops to that level. Especially important for characters that use skills constantly.
metin.Genie ekranının sağ alt tarafında karakt: At the bottom right of the Genie screen there is a special target list where you choose which monsters your character attacks. With this system you can stop Genie from attacking every monster around.
metin.**Mob Ekle** — Farm yapmak istediğiniz m: **Add Mob** — Add the monster you want to farm to the list.
metin.**Mob İsmini Kaydet** — Seçtiğiniz mobla: **Save Mob Name** — The names of the monsters you choose are saved and shown in your target list.
metin.**Mob Sil** — Artık saldırmak istemediği: **Remove Mob** — Remove a monster you no longer want to attack from the list.
metin.Bu özellik özellikle aynı slotta birden: This feature is a big advantage especially in zones with several kinds of monsters at the same spot.
metin.**Sadece istediğiniz mobu seçin, Genie y: **Pick only the monster you want, and Genie goes only for those targets.**
metin.PARTY HP · KENDİ HP · ATTACK RANGE: PARTY HP · OWN HP · ATTACK RANGE
metin.👥 **PARTY HP TAKİBİ** — Genie, party içe: 👥 **PARTY HP TRACKING** — Genie can track the HP of the players in your party. The support skills you set can be used according to party members' health levels. Useful especially for Priests to automate party support.
metin.❤️ **KENDİ HP'Nİ TAKİP ET** — Karakterin: ❤️ **TRACK YOUR OWN HP** — Makes your character constantly track its own health. Actions you set in Genie can be done automatically based on your HP level.
metin.📏 **ATTACK RANGE** — Attack Range ayarı: 📏 **ATTACK RANGE** — The Attack Range setting decides how far from your character Genie will attack monsters.
metin.**Düşük Range:** Karakteriniz daha dar b: **Low Range:** Your character stays in a smaller farm area.
metin.**Yüksek Range:** Daha geniş bir alandak: **High Range:** It can target monsters in a wider area.
metin.Sabit bir slotta farm yapıyorsanız karak: If you farm at a fixed spot, it's important to set Attack Range to fit your farm area so your character doesn't wander off for no reason.
metin.Genie içerisinde bulunan Misc bölümü, ot: The Misc section in Genie lets you personalize the automatic farm system in more detail. This section has very useful extra options especially for characters like Priests and Rogues.
metin.🩹 **MINOR KULLANIMI** — Rogue / Assassin: 🩹 **MINOR USAGE** — For Rogue / Assassin characters you can control Minor Healing through Genie. Minor use can be automated based on your character's HP. This way you can use the HP Potion + Minor combo more carefully while farming.
metin.GENIE AKTİFKEN SKILL BAR KİLİTLENİR: THE SKILL BAR IS LOCKED WHILE GENIE IS ACTIVE
metin.Genie aktif edildiğinde normal skill bar: When Genie is activated, your normal skill bar is locked. During this time you can't use skills manually. Your character only uses the skills and automation settings you placed in Genie.
metin.**Genie'yi durdurduğunuzda tekrar manuel: **When you stop Genie, you can go back to manual play.**
metin.**Genie'yi tek tuşla başlatıp durdurabil: **You can start and stop Genie with one button.**
metin.**HP ve MP pot yüzdelerini belirleyebili: **You can set HP and MP potion percentages.**
metin.**Saldırılacak mobları seçebilirsiniz.**: **You can choose the monsters to attack.**
metin.**Party HP ve kendi HP'nizi takip ettire: **You can have it track Party HP and your own HP.**
metin.**Attack Range değerini kendiniz ayarlay: **You can set the Attack Range yourself.**
metin.🔥 **Skilllerini ayarla • Pot oranını bel: 🔥 **Set your skills • Set your potion rate • Pick your monster • Adjust your range**
metin.🚀 BAŞLAT VE GERİSİNİ GENIE'YE BIRAK! 🚀: 🚀 HIT START AND LEAVE THE REST TO GENIE! 🚀
